title: FulfillmentAuthorization
description: Authorization for an originator to fulfill a payment request. The settler produces this declaration after authorizeFulfillment when the payment request's fulfill executor is "originator". A settler fulfill does not produce it.

version.description: Semver-shaped declaration version (MAJOR.MINOR). The major component is locked to this schema's parent directory (v1 → major must be 1).

scheme.description: Authorization scheme: EIP-3009 for an EVM destination, SOROBAN-AUTH for a Stellar one.

authorization.description: Signed authorization. For scheme EIP-3009, message_prehash is the EIP-712 TransferWithAuthorization typed data as a JSON string ({domain, types, primaryType, message}, with uint256 values as decimal strings), message is its EIP-712 digest, signature is the settler's 65-byte signature over that digest, and payload is absent. message.validBefore is the payment request's fulfillment_deadline in whole unix seconds, and message.nonce is the fulfillment quote hash. For scheme SOROBAN-AUTH the Soroban fulfillment proxy treats the authorization hash as 32 opaque bytes; the signed form is not defined here yet and the bindings do not validate this scheme.

fulfillment_quote_json.description: Raw JSON of the fulfillment quote (schemas/declarations/FulfillmentQuote/v1/schema.json), including proof metadata so its canonical quote hash can be computed.

evidence.description: Pointer to the on-chain evidence of the fulfillment authorization.

transaction_id.description: Chain transaction identifier. EVM transactions are 0x-prefixed hex, Tron and Stellar transactions are hex without that prefix, and Solana transactions are base58.

SignedMessage.description: A message that has been cryptographically signed to prove authorization. The signature proves you control the wallet that's sending funds.

message.description:
The data that was signed. Format depends on the blockchain:
- EVM: Hex-encoded message hash (with 0x prefix)
- Solana: Hex-encoded message hash (with 0x prefix)
- Tron: Hex-encoded message hash (possibly without 0x prefix)

message_prehash.description: Optional: If 'message' contains a hash, this field contains the original data before it was hashed. Useful for verification and debugging.

signature.description: The cryptographic signature proving you authorized this message. Hex-encoded with a 0x prefix on every supported chain. The signer's own public key is base58 on Solana, but the signature itself is not.

payload.description: Optional chain-specific payload containing additional signing context (e.g., delegate_signer for Solana). Preserved through the pipeline for downstream consumers.
